content:
The **Imposter Assaultron Head** is a non-automatic pistol in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

An Assaultron head which has been modified to bear some resemblance to the mythical Sheepsquatch. It is similar to the head of the Imposter Sheepsquatch designed by Calvin van Lowe.

Crafting of the item is unlocked from the Atomic Shop for 500 Atoms.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Adhesive (2) Asbestos (4) Glass (1) Plastic (5) Screw (2) Silver (3) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Atomic Shop Purchase | | Imposter Assaultron Head (1) | 

Can only be crafter by the player.

It is affected by the Grounded mutation.
